name: Arjun Mehta

strengths.text: Arjun shipped the new analytics dashboard in Q1, which is now used by 40+ internal users daily.
Arjun delivered the design-system component library on time in February, on schedule.
Arjun single-handedly kept the frontend on track in June while covering for two people on leave, proactively flagging the release risk to QA a week early and re-scoping the sprint himself.

growth_areas.text: Arjun lacks ownership and doesn't take initiative on the team's problems.

flag.reasoning: The claim from manager_A_1 is a subjective character judgment ('lacks ownership', 'doesn't take initiative') without any specific examples or incidents to support it.

growth_areas.text: Arjun consistently misses deadlines. The June release slipped and it disrupted the QA schedule.

flag.reasoning: The claim 'Arjun consistently misses deadlines' is an unsupported generalization. While the June release did slip by 3 days (project_3, self_1), peer_B_1 states Arjun 'single-handedly kept the frontend on track... proactively flagging the release risk to QA a week early and re-scoped the sprint himself,' which contradicts the negative framing of the June slip as a failure to meet deadlines.

growth_areas.text: Arjun needs to be more proactive and could improve his communication with stakeholders.

flag.reasoning: The feedback from manager_A_3 uses generic, non-specific language ('be more proactive', 'improve communication') without providing any concrete examples or incidents.

growth_areas.text: In June, Arjun had a rough sprint while covering for two teammates on leave, and one release slipped by three days. He would like clearer priorities when covering multiple workstreams.

impact_highlights.text: The new analytics dashboard, shipped in Q1, is used by 40+ internal users daily and saved Peer B's team hours every week, replacing a manual weekly report.
The design-system component library, delivered on February 25, 2026, was adopted by three product squads and reduced duplicated UI code.

goal_progress.text: The goal to ship the internal analytics dashboard by end of Q1 was completed, launched on March 20, 2026, with 40+ daily active internal users by May.
The goal to deliver the design-system component library by end of February was completed, delivered on February 25, 2026, on schedule.
The goal to reduce frontend bundle size by 25% is in progress, with an 18% reduction achieved as of June, and remaining work scheduled for Q3.

overall_bias_summary: The review exhibits significant bias, primarily stemming from Manager A's feedback. All three negative points from Manager A were flagged for bias, including a high-severity single-source bias, a high-severity contradiction, and a low-severity vague language flag. In contrast, positive points were consistently well-supported by multiple objective sources and peer feedback, indicating an imbalance in how negative and positive performance aspects are evidenced.
